3.2.P.8.1 Stability summary and conclusion.

Based on the data presented, a shelf life of 36 months is proposed when stored below 30 C in the original package.

Table 8. Long-term stability, three primary batches.

Storage: long-term conditions of 25 C / 60% RH. Time points: 0, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months.

12 months of long-term data are available for all batches. All results are within specification.

3. How to take this medicine

Adults and children weighing 40 kg or more: one tablet of 500 mg twice daily.

[Arabic leaflet. English rendering for review; the original text is not shown in this demo.]

3. How to take this medicine

Adults and children weighing 40 kg or more: 1000 mg twice daily (English rendering of the Arabic leaflet).

2.3.P.8 Stability: summary of the long-term results.

Three batches were stored at 30 C / 65% RH. Results at 12 months are within specification. See Module 3.2.P.8 for the full tables.
